mapper.select: SELECT PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO , PASSER_CODE FROM PASS_INTRODUCTION WHERE PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO = #{passIntroductionNo}

SELECT pi.PASSER_CODE, pi.PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO, a.APPLICANT_ID, a.USER_ID,
rn.RECRUITMENT_NO, rn.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, rn.JOB_CODE, rn.USER_ID as COM_ID, c.COM_NAME,
r.RESUME_NO, r.RESUME_NAME,
i.INTRODUCTION_NO, i.INTRODUCTION_NAME, i.INTRODUCTION_CREATE_DATE,
iq.QUESTION_NO, iq.QUESTION, iq.CONTENT,
e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE, e.GRADUATE_YN, e.LOCATION, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE
FROM PASS_INTRODUCTION pi JOIN PASSER p ON pi.PASSER_CODE = p.PASSER_NO AND p.PASSER_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND p.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y'
JOIN APPLICANT a ON p.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID AND a.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE IS NULL
JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE rn ON a.RECRUITMENT_NO = rn.RECRUITMENT_NO AND rn.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL
JOIN COMPANY c ON rn.USER_ID = c.USER_ID
JOIN RESUME r ON a.RESUME_NO = r.RESUME_NO AND r.RESUME_DELETE_DATE IS NULL
JOIN INTRODUCTION i ON pi.PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO = i.INTRODUCTION_NO AND i.INTRODUCTION_DELETE_DATE IS NULL
LEFT JOIN INTRODUCTION_QUESTION iq ON i.INTRODUCTION_NO = iq.INTRODUCTION_NO
LEFT JOIN EDUCATION e ON r.RESUME_NO = e.RESUME_NO AND e.DELETE_DATE IS NULL WHERE c.USER_ID = #{comId} ORDER BY p.PASSER_NO, iq.QUESTION_NO, e.EDUCATION_NO
